text:
maria: Quick accessibility note from this afternoon — the right-hand 'Model sessions' virtualized list is losing keyboard focus when you press Enter to open an item. Repro steps: open Console > Models > open sessions panel, Tab to the list, use Arrow keys to move, press Enter, panel opens but the visual focus ring disappears and Tab feels like it skips the details. Can someone try NVDA/VoiceOver too?

ken: repro'd on mac + VoiceOver. Focus outline goes invisible after activation. Looks like we switch DOM nodes during the open animation so roving tabindex/active element gets reset.

jess: saw the same on Windows + NVDA. Also noticed screen reader sometimes reads the previous list item instead of the newly expanded details — possibly due to virtualization (items removed/added) and no announcement to SR.

tay: quick theory — we rely on roving tabindex for perf, but virtualized list recreates nodes on open. Maybe switch to aria-activedescendant for focus momentum and keep the DOM stable? aria-activedescendant lets us keep a single focusable container while SR sees the active item.

maria: yeah i was thinking that. aria-activedescendant + a stable container could avoid losing focus while we mount the details panel. Need to confirm compatibility with VoiceOver (it treats aria-activedescendant differently).

samir: FYI a11y-bot run: "keyboard-check — failed — focus lost after activation" (automated):eyes: — log: `/logs/a11y/1746501234/list-activation.log`

ken: if we go aria-activedescendant we should also add a polite live region announcement on open: `aria-live="polite"` with a short phrase like "Session details opened" so SR users get clear context, and ensure we remove `aria-hidden` from the expanded subtree only after SR has announced.

jess: agree — also suggest ensuring contrast for the focus ring (`2px` visible outline) and not relying on box-shadow-only on the primary token; low-vision users reported it being hard to see on high-brightness themes.

tay: small CSS snippet that helped in my local patch: `:root { --a11y-focus: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--interactive) 80%, black 20%); } .list-item:focus-visible { outline: var(--a11y-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }`

maria: nice. Can someone pair on a tiny experiment to swap roving tabindex -> aria-activedescendant for the virtualized list and include a polite live region + explicit SR-friendly announce? If it pans out, we can ship behind an FF.

samir: i'll take a first pass, will open a small PR with notes and link it here. Planning to add `data-a11y-experiment` flag and test with VoiceOver + NVDA.

a11y-bot: Reminder: when changing focus strategy, add regression prompt set: `sessions-activation` with scenarios for keyboard-only, screen reader, and reduced-motion.

maria: perfect — thanks. tagging @ken @jess for review when the PR is up. :thumbsup:

samir: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4782 — draft, includes aria-activedescendant toggle + live region + unit test for focus retention.

ken: looking now. quick note — ensure virtualization still unmounts offscreen items to keep perf; aria-activedescendant shouldn't force us to render everything. Use `aria-owns` sparingly if needed.

jess: one more nit: add a short SR-friendly label for the container like `role="listbox" aria-label="Session list (keyboard navigation enabled)"` so screen readers expose the control type.

maria: thanks team — follow-up in PR review. we'll run a small dogfood with a few engineers on VA before rolling to canary. :sparkles:
